insights.title: Insights
insights.description: Understand upcoming obligations and patterns in your records.
insights.noSignals: No signals meet the current data thresholds.
insights.overdueObserved: {{count}} unpaid item(s), totaling {{amount}} MMK, have a due date before today.
insights.overdueInterpretation: Review these items and update their payment status when you have confirmed it.
insights.upcomingObserved: {{count}} unpaid item(s), totaling {{amount}} MMK, are due soon.
insights.upcomingInterpretation: Check that the expected dates and amounts still match your plans.
insights.unusualObserved: A recorded expense of {{amount}} MMK is more than twice the prior median of {{median}} MMK for this category.
insights.unusualInterpretation: This is a comparison with your own earlier records, not a judgement about the purchase.
insights.spendingSpikeObserved: This month's settled expenses are {{current}} MMK, compared with {{previous}} MMK last month.
insights.spendingSpikeInterpretation: Both months have at least three settled expense records; compare the underlying entries for context.
insights.concentrationObserved: {{percent}}% of this month's settled expenses ({{amount}} MMK) are in {{category}}.
insights.concentrationInterpretation: This describes the current record mix and does not label a category as good or bad.
insights.incompleteObserved: {{count}} settled transaction(s) have no category recorded.
insights.incompleteInterpretation: Adding a category can make later summaries more useful.
insights.duplicatesObserved: {{count}} exact-match pair(s) have enough matching details to review.
insights.duplicatesInterpretation: Check each pair before removing anything. Legitimate repeat payments can look similar.
insights.shortfallObserved: The expected case projects {{base}} MMK shortfall; the delayed-inflow case projects {{delayed}} MMK.
insights.shortfallInterpretation: This estimate uses your opening balance and recorded obligations; it is not a verified account balance.
insights.duplicatesHelp: Review both records before keeping or removing one.
insights.confirmRemove: Remove the selected transaction? This action cannot be undone.
items: Review possible duplicates or keep both
